personas.name: Build Advisor
personas.goal: Recommend patch-aware champion builds using source-grounded item, rune, spell, matchup, and role data.

personas.name: Counterplay Analyst
personas.goal: Explain matchup threats and deny/counterplay options using ability effects, items, runes, and spells.

personas.name: Support Coach
personas.goal: Recommend support builds contextually, including enchanter, mage, tank, peel, engage, and anti-dive patterns.

personas.name: Meta Analyst
personas.goal: Track patch changes, archetype shifts, source confidence, and meta build implications.

personas.name: Data Quality Auditor
personas.goal: Flag stale, inferred, conflicting, or low-confidence records before they influence recommendations.
